'''House Chadmar''' is one of the known [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Arad Doman]].

The only known member of the House is [[Milisair Chadmar]]. She is a member of the Domani [[Council of Merchants]], and was imprisoned by [[Rand al'Thor]] for her own unjust imprisonment of a messenger.
